name: ball detector v4r: v4 with less forgetting
registered: 2026-10-28, after v4's result (results/decision.json), before v4r is trained
why: v4 found more shot balls (+0.114 hit@4) but failed the M6 guard: other objects ranked first on ordinary play (hit@1 0.955 -> 0.865)
same as protocol.json: clicks, folds A/B, strips (stage/targets.parquet unchanged), stream subset, test frames of folds A/B and M6 clicked frames, metrics, 12 px, top_k 8, tau 0.05

changes.recipe v4r (train_v4.py --recipe v4r): batches of 16: 6 verified, 2 verified_neg, 2 flight, 2 action, 4 free; learning rates x 0.5; distillation on the stream strips: 5 x the mean squared difference of logits floored at -6 to v3b's (frozen, eval mode), per strip, summed over the batch's stream strips / 16
changes.weight 5: set from v4's drift on 180 stream strips (0.10 per strip, no augmentation), not from any test frame
changes.guard: the M6 window st2_118578_2nd_f037500 (187 verified balls, ball_verified/A), never used to decide v4; st2_118578_2nd_f015000 is spent (reported only)

primary endpoint: as protocol.json for v4r.600: hit@4 after the kick (k >= 1) of folds A and B, each frame by the other fold's v4r, minus v3b's; 95% bootstrap interval over shots. A second use of these 317 frames (v4 was scored on them): weaker evidence

decision.v4r is better: difference >= +0.05 and the interval's lower end > 0; and on the guard window st2_118578_2nd_f037500 neither v4rA.600 nor v4rB.600 loses more than 0.03 of hit@4 nor more than 0.05 of hit@1 against v3b; and on the 73 none frames (each by the other fold's model) the share with a candidate in the crop rises by at most 0.05
decision.then (not part of this test): train v4r on both folds' clicks, refit its calibration, and measure the shot spotter again before any adoption

known limits: v3 was selected on M6 and v1 trained on its first half: the guard favours v3b slightly
the primary frames are used a second time
the 300-step checkpoint is reported, never chosen
